comparator.name: English Language and Culture
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh current official product verifies nine first-year and eleven selected second-year units totaling 60+60 EC. The displayed-first British literature option is instantiated independently in each semester, and Early Modern Everyday English is selected by published order. Outgoing Language Acquisition 5/6 is explicitly last offered in 2026–2027 while the entrant third year changes significantly in 2027–2028; it is excluded.
